scope: Shared geometric core and off-atom t/m interface study. This is a different library and split from the earlier studies below.

experiments.label: Training reconstruction
experiments.title: 16 of 16 training targets reconstructed
experiments.description: Connected periodic fillings, independently checked against raw atoms, exact rational t-sums and approximate Euclidean markings. Target coordinates and finite motif poses are supplied; source connection choices are not fixed. This is training recovery, not held-out transfer or growth.

experiments.label: Held-out pair graphs
experiments.title: 5 of 16 held-out pair graphs connected
experiments.description: A weaker diagnostic, not a GCTS filling: recurring frozen interfaces connect the supplied motif occurrences. Connections were fitted on four training frames per phase. The original pose per motif is fixed.

experiments.label: Allow alternate poses
experiments.title: 13 of 16 with consistent alternative poses
experiments.description: Same frozen pair models and same targets. A maximum-edge optimization chooses one atom-valid pose per motif, consistently across all its connections. Independent replay verifies geometry and periodic paths. This diagnostic is not the base tree search and does not check joint t/m filling.

experiments.label: More training data
experiments.title: 98 of 100 larger-study pair graphs connected
experiments.description: Twenty-five training and twenty-five evaluation frames per phase; original fixed poses. Independent replay passes. The evaluation cohort is larger than in the previous views, so these totals are not a same-target success-rate comparison. Full-decoration reconstruction is not established.

trainingSearch.excludedCosts: Geometry and interface learning, contact enumeration, compilation, process startup and independent verification.

oxalic.scope: Completed larger-budget cohort; later branch-order controls are excluded from this frozen snapshot. Known target positions and finite poses, not transfer or growth.

provenance.conditionLimit: Paper-level common sampling protocol, not independently verified per-frame conditions or independent trajectories. The released VIII cell count differs from the paper's stated simulation cell.

limits: No end-to-end validated material family or blind material growth.
One shared three-site core, but the pilot's 1472 whole-decoration types each occur in only one training frame.
Pair-graph connectivity is not joint GCTS realizability.
Finite positive poses do not exhaust continuous rotations within tolerance.
No GCTS-versus-unmarked or MD speedup claim.
